initial-dialogue.npc: Hello adventurer, welcome to the Entrana furnace.
Would you like me to explain my craft to you?

options.text: Yes please. I'd be fascinated to hear what you do.

steps.player: Yes please. I'd be fascinated to hear what you do.

steps.npc: I'm extremely pleased to hear that! I've always wanted an apprentice. Let me talk you through the secrets of glassblowing.

Glass is made from soda ash and silica. We get our soda ash by collecting seaweed from the rocks - the prevailing currents make the north-west corner of the island the best place to find it, it can also be found in

your nets sometimes when you're fishing, on Karamja island or at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony in the nets there. To turn seaweed into soda ash, all you need to do is burn it on a fire. Feel free to use the range in
my house for that; it's the one directly west of here. Next we collect sand from the sandpit that you'll also find just west of here, there are others located in Yanille and Shilo Village.
You'll need a bucket to carry it in. Tell you what, you can have this old one of mine.
Bring the sand and the soda ash back here and melt them together in the furnace, and there you have it - molten glass!

There are many things you can use the molten glass for once you have made it. Depending on how talented you are, you could try turning it into something, like a fishbowl, for example. If you'd like to try your hand at
the fine art of glassblowing you can use my spare glassblowing pipe. I think I left it on the chest of drawers in my house this morning.
Alternatively I am always happy to buy the molten glass from you, saves me running about making it for myself.

steps.player: That sounds good. How much will you pay me?

steps.npc: Tell you what, because you've been interested in my art, I'll pay you the premium price of 20 gold pieces for each piece of molten glass you bring me

options.text: No thanks, I doubt I'll ever turn my hand to glassblowing.

steps.player: No thanks, I doubt I'll ever turn my hand to glassblowing.

steps.npc: Ok, suit yourself. Nobody seems to be interested in the skilled crafts these days.
If you should change your mind, come back and talk to me.

subsequent-dialogue-after-discussing-gla.npc: Ah [player name], have you come to sell me some molten glass?

steps.text: If the player has molten glass:

steps.npc: Fantastic! Let's see, for that much glass I could pay you ...
... [amount] gold pieces!

options.text: Are you mad? I've run all over the island to make this glass.

steps.player: Are you mad? I've run all over the island to make this glass.

steps.npc: Pity. Well you can find me here if you change your mind.

options.text: Sure, that sounds like a fair price.

steps.player: Sure, that sounds like a fair price.

steps.npc: Here you are then.
Thanks very much, [player name]. I'll buy any more that you bring.

steps.text: If the player has no molten glass:

steps.npc: Umm, not much point me trying to pay you for glass you don't have, is there?

steps.player: Well, actually, if you don't mind... question then.

steps.npc: I'll make it simple for you. You bring glass, me pay shiny gold coins.
Oh.
...errr, well should you get any I'm quite happy to pay for it. Remember, I'll pay you 20 gold pieces for each piece of molten glass you get for me.
So what did you want to talk to me about then?

options.text: Could you tell me how to make molten glass again, please?

steps.player: Could you tell me how to make molten glass again, please?

steps.npc: Well, I am very busy at the moment, but I guess I can take 5 minutes off for my favourite student.

Glass is made from soda ash and silica. We get our soda ash by collecting seaweed from the rocks - the prevailing currents make the north-west corner of the island the best place to find it, it can also be found in

your nets sometimes when you're fishing, on Karamja island or at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony in the nets there. To turn seaweed into soda ash, all you need to do is burn it on a fire. Feel free to use the range in

Fritz the Glassblower: my house for that; it's the one directly west of here. Next we collect sand from the sandpit that you'll also find just west of here, there are others located in Yanille and Shilo Village.
You can use the bucket I gave you earlier.

steps.text: If the player has an empty bucket in their inventory:
If the player doesn't have an empty bucket in their inventory:

steps.player: I'm afraid I don't have that bucket with me. Could you give me another one, please?

steps.npc: Do I look like I'm made of buckets? You'll just have to buy another from a general store.

options.text: I just thought I'd drop in and say hello.

steps.player: I just thought I'd drop in and say hello.

steps.npc: Hello then. I'm afraid I don't have any time to chat though. The druids of Taverley have placed a huge order for glass vials, so I'm very busy.
